children: , a publicly traded, applied multimodal AI-powered physical safety and security technology company, announced today its participation at the upcoming Moody Capital Solutions 2026 Disruptive Growth & Life Sciences Conference, taking place September 9-10, 2026, in New York City. Scott M. Boruff, CEO and Chairman, and Michael Hrynuik, CFO, will be attending the conference, delivering an investor presentation, and participating in scheduled 1-on-1 meetings with investors.
The Westin New York Grand Central, 212 E 42nd St, New York, NY
Scott M. Boruff, CEO and Chairman, and Michael Hrynuik, CFO

is a publicly traded technology company providing proprietary, applied multimodal, AI-powered physical safety solutions in its mission to help save lives. The Company’s platform delivers threat detection, incident notification, and security capabilities designed to support protection of people and property across multiple sectors, including K-12 education, senior living, addiction treatment, and houses of worship. About the Moody Capital Solutions 2026 Disruptive Growth & Life Sciences Conference

The Moody Capital Solutions 2026 Disruptive Growth & Life Sciences Conference brings together public and private growth companies, pioneering innovators, investors, C-suite executives and industry professionals across biotechnology, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, healthcare technology and other growth industries. The two-day conference features company presentations, one-on-one investor meetings, fireside chats, capital markets and financing panels, and networking opportunities with institutional investors and family offices.
